scope: KARTA private tool traces and immutable initial run finalization

baseline_reproductions.scope: uncertain empty cycle without execution key

verification.review: Independent source review: reported defects fixed; no further blocking defect found in the bounded scope.

contracts: metadata_only is server-owned and independent of sensitive approval policy
a private or unknown tool protects the whole cycle, including mixed and deferred calls
private data is removed from run traces, returned outcomes and notification bodies; execution and approval payloads remain intact
privacy marker persists in tools_used and is inherited at approval resolution and replay
parent trace lookup is scoped by run id, user id and agent type; uncertain lookup minimizes diagnostics
first completion JSON is fixed; conditional write requires matching id/user/agent/status running/duration_ms NULL
one bounded second close uses the same candidate; no tool or provider replay
uncertain finalization forbids automatic retry, including empty cycles without an execution key
secondary bookkeeping errors do not overwrite committed action or approval evidence
limits: Supabase transport and provider calls simulated; PostgreSQL predicates exercised using one PGlite backend
no production deployment, real Jev call, semantic qualification, cost/speed/energy benchmark or distributed load test
legacy tools keep their traces outside protected cycles; historical database rows are not rewritten
authorized approval payloads remain stored; per-tool/provider logging and retention are outside this change
real admission, atomic monetary quotas, revocation, settlement and business consumption of Jev judgments remain host prerequisites
PR14 sibling test typing requires retaining duration_ms null, is() signature and committed-success expectation on consolidation
GitHub CI results are reported separately and are not inferred from this local verification
